meta.title: Rayrun Bot
meta.description: Adds a Bots entry and the v0.1 three-column shell: chat list, conversation with approval cards, details, setup and settings. Real bots and sessions run on your own Rayrun cloud computer. Sample data is available only in the explicit ?preview=1 demo.

preview.demoBanner: Demo data. Nothing here is real.

chat.simulatedReply: Done. This reply is simulated in the preview; the approval below is also local.
chat.simulatedApprovalTitle: Post the simulated result to the team channel
chat.runtimeUnavailable: The cloud runtime is unavailable. Install dsh-rayrun-computer and reload DSH.
chat.connectRayrun: Connect Rayrun in setup before sending.
chat.machineBusy: The cloud computer is busy. Try again shortly.
chat.balanceLow: The Rayrun balance is low. Add credit before sending.
chat.queueFull: Too many messages are queued. Wait for a reply.
chat.messageInvalid: That message can't be sent: it is empty, too long, or invalid.

chat.turnTimeout: The page stopped waiting, but the cloud turn may still be running. Refresh to check the result.
chat.turnInterrupted: The previous turn was interrupted. Send it again.
chat.machineStopped: Your cloud computer is stopped or unavailable. Open it from Details or the cloud-computer plugin, then send again.

chat.workerNoReply: The cloud worker ended without writing reply.md. Check its session for the provider error; a missing DeepSeek credential (MISSING_CREDENTIAL) prevents a reply. Add a model credential or recreate the computer with one.

newBot.title: New bot
newBot.sub: Give it a name and one job. Instructions can be changed later.
newBot.monogramHint: Letter avatar · color is assigned from the name
newBot.name: Name
newBot.placeholder: You are {name}, a teammate on the user's team. Your job: …
newBot.defaultJob: Summarises weekly PRs and drafts the digest

persona.template:
You are {name}, a teammate on the user's team.
Your job: {job}.
Work in short, factual updates. Say what you did, what you did not do, and what you need next. Ask before any action that leaves this computer (messages, publishing, spending, another machine). Never claim work you have not verified.
If something is unclear, ask one question instead of guessing.

setup.title: Set up Rayrun Bot
setup.sub: Four steps. Each one says what is missing and where to fix it.
setup.dependencyBody: Cloud computers come from the separate dsh-rayrun-computer plugin. The host checks whether it is installed; fix it and restart DSH before connecting Rayrun.
setup.dependencyMissing: Missing — install dsh-rayrun-computer, then restart DSH.
setup.rayrunBody: The cloud computer is provided by Rayrun. Paste a Rayrun API token; the cloud-computer plugin stores it in the DSH vault.
setup.tokenHint: Paste a Rayrun API token from the console. The cloud-computer plugin stores it in the DSH vault.
setup.tokenRequired: Paste a Rayrun API token first.
setup.tokenRejected: Rayrun rejected this API token. Check the token and try again.
setup.computerBody: Bots creates one cloud computer on your Rayrun account. It is billable while it runs. The DeepSeek key becomes its model credential and does not go into the workspace.
setup.computerExistingHint: The cloud-computer plugin owns this machine's settings and model credential.
setup.computerNeedsRayrun: Connect Rayrun on the previous step before creating a computer.
setup.computerLoadFailed: Could not read your Rayrun computers: {message}
setup.computerKeyHint: New computers need a DeepSeek credential for cloud DSH turns. Leave this blank only if this computer or your Rayrun defaults already provide one.
setup.computerCost: Creates a billable machine on your Rayrun account. Bots never destroys it.
setup.botBody: Give it a name and one job. It is saved to your local roster and runs on your cloud computer.
setup.imageUnsupported: This image runs a shell oneshot and will not start a DSH worker. Use deepseek-harness@1 or another image that starts DSH headless.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Account, usage, and the few settings this plugin owns.
settings.rayrunHint: Token stays in the DSH vault · host side only
settings.hostHint: Same-origin health check. No Rayrun token or DeepSeek key.
settings.hostLoaded: Loaded · v{version} · bot layer not ready
settings.hostDepMissing: Cloud-computer plugin missing — install dsh-rayrun-computer, then restart DSH.
settings.usageHint: From your Rayrun account. Same-origin RPC; no token in the page.
settings.lowBalanceHint: Show a notice when the balance drops below this.
settings.languageHint: Chinese is primary; English is available.
settings.updatesHint: Check the npm registry for a newer dsh-rayrun-bots build. Nothing is downloaded or installed and no token is sent.
settings.upToDate: You are on the newest {channel} build (v{current}).
settings.updateCommandHint: Run this in a terminal, then restart DSH. The cloud-computer plugin stays installed:
settings.updateCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select the command manually.
settings.updateRestart: This is a notice only; nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
settings.computerHint: Updates the computer all bots share. Files and sign-ins are kept; installed apps and packages are removed. After a successful update, the old computer and its workspace are destroyed. All bots update together.
settings.computerUpdateHint: Creates a new computer and copies the preserved paths. After a successful update, the old computer and its workspace are destroyed (irreversible).
settings.computerTarget: New image: {image}. Bots keeps the DeepSeek credential already bound to this computer, or uses the account's model credential.
settings.computerNotConnected: Connect Rayrun to manage the bot computer.
settings.computerBillable: This creates a billable computer on your Rayrun account. On success the old computer is destroyed and cannot be recovered.
settings.computerUpdating: Updating… creating the new computer and copying data. Do not close this page.
settings.computerUpdated: Computer updated to {image}. The previous computer {name} was destroyed.
settings.computerUpdatedKept: Computer updated to {image}. The previous computer {name} could not be destroyed and is stopped; clean it up manually.
